title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram - Solution
intuition: Given an array of integers heights representing the histogram's bar height where the width of each bar is 1, find the area of the largest rectangle in the histogram.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
code:
def solution(heights):
    stack = []
    max_area = 0
    heights = heights + [0]
    for i, h in enumerate(heights):
        while stack and heights[stack[-1]] > h:
            height = heights[stack.pop()]
            width = i if not stack else i - stack[-1] - 1
            max_area = max(max_area, height * width)
        stack.append(i)
    return max_area
common_mistakes: Use a stack to maintain index of bars in increasing order.
When a shorter bar is encountered, pop elements to calculate rectangle areas.
